name: Fantasy Opposite
source:
Your journey begins in the Fantasy world of Grimburg, a city populated by all characters from your favorite fairy tales. Little Red Riding Hood, Snow White, Cinderella, Alice in Wonderland..................

Have you ever wondered what it would be like if you could have a romantic relationship with one of these characters?

If that is what you are looking for, then this game is for you! But of course, it won't be so dynamic. Come on, it's already 21 st century. We need a little bit of change to our fantasy characters. A Snow White who is a goth? Big Bad Wolf that is actually kind to everyone?! Red Riding Hood is a good hunter that wants to trap you!?! Cinderella is a big bully and extorts you all the time!?!?!
